scenes.spoken_text: Create a coordinated manufacturing package that connects carcass details, hardware, site conditions and an inspectable installation sequence.
scenes.caption: Create a coordinated manufacturing package that connects carcass details, hardware, site conditions and an inspectable installation sequence.

scenes.spoken_text: Reconcile plans, elevations, sections, cut lists, appliances and hardware by compatible revisions. Distinguish carcass, finished-part and cutting dimensions according to edge details. Mark unresolved device/service inputs and do not release affected parts as fully approved.
scenes.caption: A release identifies its references and open items.

scenes.display_title: Link hardware to units and parts
scenes.spoken_text: For each hardware item record product code, handing, quantity, cabinet and approved drilling reference. Distinguish a purchased set from its component parts to avoid double ordering. Product changes reopen front, carcass, machining and motion coordination before procurement.
scenes.caption: A set and its components are different counting units.

scenes.spoken_text: Link site readiness to delivery and assembly of units, worktops and devices under their references. Put hold points before fixing/services are concealed and assign inspectors. Check alignment, operation and samples, then record corrections and reinspection; do not improvise load tests.
scenes.caption: Acceptance of hidden work precedes concealment.

scenes.spoken_text: The schedule orders a complete pull-out set and accidentally reorders its included components. Check the set contents, separate genuine additions and correct procurement. Decision: reconcile the purchasing unit before ordering.
scenes.caption: Decision: reconcile the purchasing unit before ordering.

scenes.display_title: Submit an assembly detail, hardware schedule and installation plan with three inspection hold points and open items.
scenes.spoken_text: Submit an assembly detail, hardware schedule and installation plan with three inspection hold points and open items.
